name: Sant Pere de Riudebitlles (Spain)
description: Divided by two ascending diagonals into three parts, a dark blue hoist part twice the size of the others bearing a yellow sprig, a white middle band and a yellow fly.
history: The flag was approved on 20 November 1997; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided by ascending diagonals into three parts: that at the hoist, twice the others, dark blue; the middle white; and that at the fly yellow.

features.role: white band between the dark blue and the yellow
sprig of leaves in the upper hoist
